title: Educator / Parent Email
caption:
Subject: A middle-school anime that's secretly the CASEL five

Hi [name],

I make an animated series called Chill Crew. It's a shonen-style show about four kids at a middle school whose emotions are visible — fire, lightning, mist, stone — four seconds before they get out of hand. Each of the eight episodes is built on one CASEL competency; the kids never hear the word "competency," they just watch a crew teach each other to catch it, vent it, and shape it.

Episode 1 premieres this Thursday, October 1, at 4 pm: [link]. Episodes are 90 seconds. The attached one-pager maps each episode to its competency with a discussion prompt you can use the same day.

If it's useful, share it with your grade team or post it for families. If it's not, tell me why — the season is written but the edit isn't locked.

Ella Sanders
McCray Learning Lab
